text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide has made dramatic improvements ever since summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has always been an imposing figure to Narita Taishin, ever since they ran a race together as children.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket is still eager to win, undaunted by Biwa Hayahide, which sends Narita Taishin into a panic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fear of being left behind pushes Narita Taishin to act recklessly. In her impatience, she ends up damaging her health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin tearfully begs to run in the Kikuka Sho because racing and winning are all that she has.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm unable to deny her wish—not when her pleas are so heartrending.
